definitions.explanation: Knowledge or guidance passed on from a teacher.
A principle to be learned from an experience.

notes:
{教|おし}え is the noun form of ⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ (to teach). It covers three main meanings: personal instruction from a teacher or mentor, religious/philosophical doctrine, and moral lessons drawn from experience.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {教|おし}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to uphold/follow teachings
- {教|おし}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive instruction
- {教|おし}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to obey/follow teachings
- {教|おし}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説|と}く→説く：14245_toku⟧: to preach/expound teachings

USAGE BY SENSE:
- Personal: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え, ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え
- Religious: ⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え, ⟦キリスト→キリスト：24422_kirisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え
- Moral: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え, ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え
